senses.gloss: ख्या vt. or vi. 2P (in the non-conjugational tenses U) (pp. ख्यात) 1. To tell, to communicate; (with the dat. of the person addressed); 2. to be known.With अभि-, to be known, Yaj.iii.301.With आ-, 1. to tell, to narrate, to communicate, इदमाख्याहि शतशः Ve.vi., तथेति प्रतिपन्नाय नृपायाचख्यौ R.xv.72, Bg.xi.31, xviii.63, R.xii.42, 91, ii.11; 2. to call, to denominate, R.x.21.With परि-, to be well known.With प्र-, to be well known.With प्रत्या-, 1. to decline, to refuse, to reject; 2. to deny; 3. to interdict; 4. to surpass, to excel.With वि-, to be famous.With व्या-, 1. to explain, e.g. व्याख्यातुं कुशलाः केचित् ग्रंथान्; 2. to tell, to communicate, Bt.xiv.113; 3. to call, to name, e.g. (विद्वद्व्रूंदैः) व्याख्याता सा विद्युन्माला.With सम्-, 1. to enumerate, to count, to sum up, to calculate.
ख्या Pass. (ख्यायते) to be known, to be named, Bt.vi.97.
ख्या Caus. (ख्यापयति-ते) 1. to make known, to proclaim, to relate, to declare, M.vii.201, xi.99; 2. to make renowned, to praise.
ख्यात a. (f. ता) 1. Known, R.xviii.6; 2. named, denominated, called; 3. told; 4. celebrated, famous, notorious.
ख्यात a. (f. ता) 1. Known, R.xviii.6; 2. named, denominated, called; 3. told; 4. celebrated, famous, notorious.

ख्याति f. 1. Renown, fame, glory, celebrity, M.xii.36; 2. a name, a title; 3. praise; 4. narration; 5. the faculty of discriminating objects by appropriate designation, knowledge (in Phil.), Sis.iv.55.
ख्यापन n. 1. Declaring, divulging; 2. confessing, publicly declaring, M.xi.227; 3. making renowned, celebrating.
